about.text: "clove cheese", cows' milk cheese with clove and cumin from Friesland.

sources.text: Gouda-style cheese from skimmed pasteurised cow's milk (23% fat) with cloves and cumin; unprotected name variant of kanterkaas (the skim-milk kanternagelkaas is the protected form); ripening time not found
